messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: simulate annealing with exact-rational area scoring under simplex constraints

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "Simulated annealing with exact-rational area scoring under simplex constraints converges to an optimal configuration where the 13 points are partitioned into two interlocking hexagonal sublattices offset by vector (1/6, 1/6), yielding a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/72. The exact-rational scoring eliminates floating-point comparison errors during annealing acceptance, while simplex constraints (each point represented as convex combinations of triangle vertices) maintain the unit-square boundary condition without inequality checks."}
